name: Claro Tiles
description: Adds custom CSS tile styling to the Claro admin theme.
project_description:
The claro_tiles module is a custom Drupal 10 module designed to enhance the visual appeal of the Drupal admin panel by transforming the traditional action lines into a tile-based layout. This module provides a fresh and modern look to the admin interface, improving readability and usability.

 composer require drupal/claro_tiles 

 Features 
 Upon enabling this module, the traditional line-based layout of the admin panel is transformed into a more visually appealing and touch-friendly tile-based layout. 

 Additional Requirements 
 This module requires Drupal Claro admin theme enabled.
